5.description: [Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] The on-use spell slot of Atiesh now holds a transform spell for every version, allowing the user to cycle through the different versions of Atiesh.

[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] Atiesh no longer summons the portal to Karazhan on use. Instead equipping any Atiesh now teaches the player Portal: Karazhan, wish can be found under the General tab in players spell book. Unequipping Atiesh unlearns the portal automatically.

[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] All auras of Atiesh now diminish in effect with the carriers level by 5% for every level above 60. This means at level 70 their effect is halfed, at 80 they do not grant anymore benefit.

[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] All auras of Atiesh now effect the entire raid rather then just the group of the carrier and the radius has been increased to 40 yards up from 30.
[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] Atiesh no longer needs to be reequiped after death to activate its aura.
[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] The Crit Rating aura of Atiesh now effects all crit rating, previously would only effect spell crit rating.
[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] Added a fourth aura option granting 30 Haste Rating.
[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] Renamed the different auras applied by the Atieshs to unique names, making it easier to distinquish them.
[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] Corrected an issue where some versions of Atiesh had wrong spells applied.
[Pending Restart] [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian] Corrected an issue where some versions of Atiesh would crash players clients if player hovered over them with their mouse.

7.description: + [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Silence in the Library Worldforged Mystic Enchantment was set to Arcane damage, and was unable to crit. It's now properly doing Physical damage and can inflict critical strikes.

7.description: [Pending Restart] [Prayer of Preservation] Preservation has had its Base Healing and coefficient reduced by 40%. Developer Notes: These changes come to curb the dominance of Prayer of Preservation especially inside of the Mythic+ environment. We are reviewing changes to troublesome Mythic+ affixes that can only be effectively dealt with in an efficient manner by Prayer of Preservation but also raid mechanics where Prayer of Preservation was used to strong arm the encounters in order to make them feel more diversified in the builds that can effectively tackle these kinds of mechanics in future.
[Pending Restart] [Prayer of Preservation] Prayer of Preservation now has a 15 second cooldown up from 12 seconds.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Penance bolts procced from Prayers of the Penitent was doing less damage then intended, and not scaling properly from spell damage.

1.description: [Pending restart] Fixed an issue where the Agility One-Handed bonus reduced the global cooldown of certain abilities more than the intended 10%.

[Pending restart] The Agility One-Handed bonus now also reduces the cost (energy, rage or mana) of affected melee abilities by 10%. This is intended to offset the increased cost that comes with using abilities faster, so that your resource usage doesn't go up when you get this bonus.

0.description: Scholomance Door no longer requires the key to gain access to the door that allows you to enter the dungeon (this was an unnecessary restriction that added tension with the Mythic+ system).

3.description: [Website] Implemented a visual notifier to all Bug Reports that have been responded to by a member of the Ascension Staff Team to make communication more visible.

8.description: Updated the daily dungeon diving quests for Upper and Lower Scholomance, They are separate quests that now only require the last boss of each respective dungeon.

7.description: [Pending Restart][Righteous Flames] Number of charges granted by your Inner Fire is reduced by 50%. Up from 25%. This is a temporary change to address the outlier performance of Righteous Flames while still ensuring it remains a strong option. Bigger overhaul is planned for the next major update.

[Charged Tides] Fixed an issue where in some circumstances you could generate a stack of Charged Tides but instantly consume the stack generated despite the cast not benefitting from Charged Tides effects.
[Charged Tides] Fixed an issue where Charged Tides effects weren't being consumed by Living Lightning. It will now correctly benefit from and consume the effects of Charged Tides.
